model_state: initial weights (before the first optimizer step)
statistic: median pairwise distance of pair vectors w = [z1; z2] over the positive pairs and one cyclic-shift partner per image (i < j, first 4096 rows)
features: sqrt(2/m) cos(Omega w + b), Omega = Omega0 / sigma fixed, read-out theta (m + 1 trainable), tanh output
